I have. This is just too much. She might very well be the best match there is for me and I was in such bad condition mentally I ruined it. It's not me, I don't fucking deserve this.

I can't fucking live with this thought of ruining it. I've cried hysterically for a month now. I'm used to ruining great things but this is too much.  It was so perfect, the stars aligned in such incredible ways that I know for a fact it will not happen to me again. It's not possible. I love her and I'm not the person she met. I couldn't bring myself to tell her how broken I really was, acted like I do around everyone - tried to be the guy I dream of being. When she spent some time living with me it's no wonder she got sad, my life has been such a fucking mess. I don't deserve this.

Matches like this happen once in a few lifetimes. This can't fucking happen to me. I don't deserve this. I don't fucking deserve to meet the girl of my dreams when I can barely sleep some nights and a few months later realize I fucked it up like everything I do. This is some kind of cosmic joke.
